home.intro: Paste a message or share a screenshot. Hakiki checks it before you send money.

guardian.acceptFailedConn: That code could not be accepted. Check your connection and try again.
guardian.empty: No guardian linked yet. Create an invite code above and share it with someone you trust.
guardian.loadFailed: Your guardians could not be loaded. Check your connection, then reload this page.
check.noEvidence: No warning signs found in the message itself.
action.shareCopied: Warning link copied. Share it to protect others.
action.shareFailed: Sharing did not work. Try again.
action.thanks: Thanks. Your note helps improve Hakiki.
action.feedbackFailed: That did not save. Try again.

error.rateLimited: Too many checks just now. Wait a little, then try again.
